title: Cauliflower Fritters
subtitle: gluten free with chickpea flour
description: Four-ingredient fritters of finely processed cauliflower, chickpea flour and egg, pan-fried until golden. Light, airy and gluten free, served with a salad or yoghurt dip.

steps.text: Process the cauliflower (cut into large florets, including the core) to crumbs in a food processor. Transfer to a bowl, add the remaining ingredients and mix to a uniform mixture.
Shape into flat patties about 4 cm across.
Heat a non-stick pan with a teaspoon of oil and fry the fritters in batches for 2 minutes on each side until browned (add a teaspoon of oil at the start of each batch).
Serve hot with a yoghurt and herb dip or a fresh leaf salad.
